bibl.title: P.Oxy. 471: Hadrian, Alexandria, and the Antinous Cult.
bibl.seg: Alessandro Galimberti, P.Oxy. 471: Hadrian, Alexandria, and the Antinous Cult.

Elena Muñiz Grijalvo, Juan Manuel Cortés Copete & Fernando Lozano Gomez (edd.), Empire and Religion. Religious Change in Greek Cities under Roman Rule = Impact of Empire. 25 (Leiden - Boston, 2017) pp. 98-111.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. III, 471 testifies the good fortune and spead of the cult of Antinous, while showing that the figure of Antinous and his relationship with Hadrian were charged with negative moral connotations, which could in turn be used in an allusive way during the indictment of a trial.
